verdict.rationale: There is no documented bulk or full-account export. Leaving would mean scripting against the bearer-token API, which returns collections of candidates, offers and departments. The XML job feed covers only currently published jobs, not your full data. Missing for 10: a documented one-click or bulk export of all account data, explicit open-format guarantees (e.g. CSV/JSON dumps), coverage of all entities (emails, events, evaluations, files), and independent corroboration of a successful full exit.
